name: adaptive-subagent-orchestrator-dev
description: [DEV] Three-stage subagent orchestration for precise routing, bounded dispatch, and evidence-backed integration.

interface.shortDescription: [DEV] Routes and coordinates bounded subagent work.
interface.longDescription: [DEV] Provides three instruction-only skills: a lightweight precision-first orchestration entry, a bounded dispatcher that applies the full delegation gate and spawns the minimum necessary subagents, and an integrator that validates required evidence and whole-result verification.
defaultPrompt: Use $adaptive-subagent-orchestrator-dev:orchestrate-subagents for explicit subagent requests or when at least two clearly independent software-engineering workstreams are visible.
If it returns DISPATCH, use $adaptive-subagent-orchestrator-dev:dispatch-subagents; after a complete DispatchManifest, use $adaptive-subagent-orchestrator-dev:integrate-subagent-results.
